svg.aria-label: Habits found in my own Go code: /health comes first — Every service starts with it, and watchdog exists just to poll it.; Handlers are factories — A method returns gin.HandlerFunc, so dependencies stay in the struct.; One place maps errors — Sentinel errors, errors.Is to 400/404, and a 500 never leaks DB text.; [] instead of null — Lists start empty, so the JSON is [] even when nothing is found.; Clamp what clients send — Default and max limits in the service, ids ≤ 0 rejected early.; Owner from auth only — user_id comes from the context, never from body or query.; 0 rows affected = 404 — Update and delete check RowsAffected instead of trusting the call.; SQL by hand — Explicit columns, RETURNING for DB-made fields, upsert, index for the query.; Fakes, not mock libs — Hand-written fakes record what they got; sqlmock only for repos.; Table tests via httptest — One router helper, a table of cases, a check that errors don't leak.; Bottom-up, one step a commit — domain → repo → service → dto → handler → routes, then review fixes.; make base — Same short Makefile in every repo: start, form, stat, base, up, db.
svg.title: Habits found in my own Go code: /health comes first — Every service starts with it, and watchdog exists just to poll it.; Handlers are factories — A method returns gin.HandlerFunc, so dependencies stay in the struct.; One place maps errors — Sentinel errors, errors.Is to 400/404, and a 500 never leaks DB text.; [] instead of null — Lists start empty, so the JSON is [] even when nothing is found.; Clamp what clients send — Default and max limits in the service, ids ≤ 0 rejected early.; Owner from auth only — user_id comes from the context, never from body or query.; 0 rows affected = 404 — Update and delete check RowsAffected instead of trusting the call.; SQL by hand — Explicit columns, RETURNING for DB-made fields, upsert, index for the query.; Fakes, not mock libs — Hand-written fakes record what they got; sqlmock only for repos.; Table tests via httptest — One router helper, a table of cases, a check that errors don't leak.; Bottom-up, one step a commit — domain → repo → service → dto → handler → routes, then review fixes.; make base — Same short Makefile in every repo: start, form, stat, base, up, db.
